settings.title: Settings
settings.recent: Recently used entries at the top of the lists (number, 0 = off):
settings.commentAuto: &Expand the comment field only when it contains something
settings.autostart: &Start Kahraman automatically when signing in to Windows
settings.autostartStore: Manage autostart: Windows Settings › Apps › Startup
settings.hotkeysInfo: Keyboard shortcuts that work anywhere in Windows. Click in the field and press the combination you want (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+H). Del or Backspace removes the shortcut.
settings.hotkeysSame: The two hotkeys must be different.
settings.reminderInfo: The question always stays on top of all other windows until it is answered – it cannot be closed.
settings.reminderMore: Additional reminders while the question is unanswered and you are working elsewhere:
settings.allowMinimize: Allow the question to be &minimized (it then flashes in the taskbar)
editor.filterTip: Shows only entries whose activity, sub-activity or comment contains the text

settings.awayInfo: Kahraman notices when you're away and asks when you're back how the time should be booked – so nothing gets lost and nothing is over-booked. Ask after:
settings.awayMin: Only ask if I was away for at least
settings.awayMenu: You can also choose a break or end of day yourself: right-click the clock › Break or End of day. "Pause questions" only stops the questions; the time keeps counting (e.g. during meetings).
